title: Welfare Schemes - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Welfare Schemes - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College, Delhi is a constituent institution of the University of Delhi, offering both teaching and non‑teaching student services. The college is accredited by NAAC with an A+ rating and ranks 31st in the NIRF national ranking. Contact details, quick links for students, and college timing information are provided on the site, with admission enquiries available from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The website is powered by WhiteCode and includes visitor and address information.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is located in Delhi and is part of the University of Delhi.
The college holds an A+ accreditation from NAAC.
